pure-announcement.rationale: This is a practitioner essay arguing for an observability pattern with an original two-model cost experiment, not a launch or release note — the author's Continue affiliation appears only as a closing aside.

duplicate.rationale: proxy-boundary-session-capture covers crash-recovery capture of conversation trees and siem-agentic-visibility-gap covers SIEM security semantics, while this note's central idea — per-iteration OTel telemetry and cost attribution for autonomous coding loops — is new to a reader of both.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The cost/iteration claims come from the author's own captured telemetry with concrete figures, and the OTel GenAI SIG and Huntley's Ralph technique are linked primary sources a reader can check.

durability.rationale: The core pattern — a passive observe-don't-control telemetry layer emitting per-iteration spans with cost and tool-call attribution for context-resetting agent loops — is a mechanism that outlives the Sonnet/Haiku version numbers and prices used only as illustrative evidence.

actionability.rationale: It specifies exactly what a loop operator should instrument (iteration count/duration/success, cost per iteration and feature by model, tool-call and file-touch patterns) and where to emit it (OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions to any OTel backend), which directly changes how someone builds a Ralph-style loop.

atomicity.rationale: One thesis — autonomous loops need a superintendent telemetry layer — stated in a paragraph, with the lint-error experiment serving as evidence for it rather than as a separate idea.
